name: SNAKES & LADDERS
title: Snakes & Ladders
blurb: Roll, climb the ladders, dodge the snakes. A new board every game. Two to six players.
description: The race up a hundred squares, with a new board dealt every game: the snakes and ladders move, but every board is checked to be fair. Tap the die to roll; land exactly on 100 to finish, and the rest play on for second and third. Two to six players; bots fill empty seats if you want them.
author: lokeshmohanty
